evidence.quote: The reduced interferometric data cubes and integrated intensity images in FITS format and the outflow spectra in ASCII format are only available in electronic form at the CDS

missing_for_reproduction: Imaging parameters (weighting, robust, cell, image size, masks, thresholds) and 12-m/7-m combination method
RADEX grid specifics and CO abundance and partition-function inputs for the mass equation
Lobe regions and annulus width for momentum flux
Literature sample values for the Class 0 and Class I relations and luminosities from Paper I
Correct archive project code (2012.0.00781.S printed versus 2012.1.00781.S in the archive)
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: On the order of 50-150 GB for the Band 7 12-m and 7-m mosaics plus the Band 3 mosaic (inferred; not stated in the paper)
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA data are public and the analysis formulas and many adopted parameters are given, but imaging settings, combination method, regions and several literature inputs are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Data are public and results are numeric, but imaging parameters, lobe regions and RADEX grid details are missing, so a reproducer could not redo the cubes and masses from the paper alone.

methods_papers.why: Momentum flux to accretion rate relation, entrainment and wind parameters, evolutionary tracks
Method for outflow mass, momentum and energy
Definitions of outflow length, velocity, dynamical time and inclination corrections
RADEX SLED fitting approach for outflow temperature

companion_papers.why: ATCA radio continuum, HCHII regions, luminosities and ZAMS comparison
Original ALMA Cycle 0 N2H+ and continuum study, global collapse and cloud infall rate
